qualification: Read-only diagnostic sampling of part of one no-noise flight; not a full-rate trace or hardware timing measurement
exit_explanation: Firmware terminated before the final handshake was sampled; the last observed sample is 0.25 ms before the 83 s end. Flight itself passed. This is a partial diagnostic trace.
layout_evidence: Exact ELF symbol addresses from arm-none-eabi-nm; field layouts from the compiled target sources fastdyn_adr.c, pid.h, gyro.h. Motor values cross-checked against the independent recorded trajectory.
limitations: Irregular sampling; reject in-progress or changed request/response handshakes
May affect emulator wall time; no claim of measured driver or hardware loop latency
Only yaw PID/gyro/RC setpoint observed; does not close all-axis onboard rate-command qualification
